pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: A 48-year-old male is admitted with severe crushing chest pain radiating to the left jaw. The ECG reveals ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF with reciprocal depressions in leads I and aVL. Which coronary artery is most likely occluded?

pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: A primigravida at 34 weeks gestation presents with sudden painless, bright red vaginal bleeding. Her vitals are stable and fetal heart rate is 144 bpm. Which nursing action is strictly contraindicated?
pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextDisplay: A primigravida at 34 weeks gestation presents with sudden painless, bright red vaginal bleeding. Her vitals are stable and fetal heart rate is 144 bpm. Which nursing action is strictly contraindicated?
pyq-norcet-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-norcet-2026.optionA: Continuous external fetal heart rate monitoring
pyq-norcet-2026.optionB: Establishing wide-bore IV access with Ringer Lactate
pyq-norcet-2026.optionC: Performing a digital vaginal examination (P/V examination)
pyq-norcet-2026.optionD: Obtaining an urgent obstetric transabdominal ultrasound
pyq-norcet-2026.answerSource: AIIMS NORCET Master Answer Key (AIIMS Notice No. 124/2024 Official Master Answer Key)
pyq-norcet-2026.explanation: In suspected placenta previa (painless bright red bleeding in third trimester), digital vaginal examination is strictly contraindicated as finger insertion can disrupt placental attachments and trigger catastrophic, life-threatening hemorrhage.

pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The solution contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL 5% Dextrose. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextDisplay: A physician prescribes Dopamine infusion at 5 mcg/kg/min for a patient weighing 70 kg. The solution contains 400 mg Dopamine in 250 mL 5% Dextrose. What should be the infusion pump rate in mL/hr?
pyq-norcet-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.

pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: Twelve hours following a subtotal thyroidectomy, a patient complains of numbness and tingling around the lips and fingers. When taking blood pressure, carpopedal spasm is observed. Which electrolyte imbalance is responsible?
pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextDisplay: Twelve hours following a subtotal thyroidectomy, a patient complains of numbness and tingling around the lips and fingers. When taking blood pressure, carpopedal spasm is observed. Which electrolyte imbalance is responsible?
pyq-norcet-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-norcet-2026.answerSource: AIIMS NORCET Master Answer Key (AIIMS Notice No. 124/2024 Official Master Answer Key)
pyq-norcet-2026.explanation: Carpopedal spasm induced by BP cuff inflation (Trousseau sign) and perioral paresthesia indicate acute hypocalcemia resulting from accidental trauma or devascularization of the parathyroid glands during thyroid surgery.

pyq-norcet-2026.optionB: 0.05 mL Intradermal in left upper arm
pyq-norcet-2026.answerSource: AIIMS NORCET Master Answer Key (AIIMS Notice No. 124/2024 Official Master Answer Key)
pyq-norcet-2026.explanation: At birth (up to 4 weeks of age), BCG vaccine is administered strictly intradermally on the left upper arm at a dose of 0.05 mL using a 26G tuberculin syringe (0.1 mL if given after 1 month of age).

pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: A mechanically ventilated patient in the ICU suddenly triggers a High Peak Inspiratory Pressure (PIP) alarm. On assessment, the nurse notes absent breath sounds on the left hemithorax, tracheal deviation to the right, and severe hypotension (BP 74/46 mmHg). What is the immediate life-saving intervention?
pyq-norcet-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-norcet-2026.optionB: Administer an urgent IV bolus of 500 mL Normal Saline
pyq-norcet-2026.optionC: Perform immediate needle decompression in the 2nd intercostal space on the left
pyq-norcet-2026.optionD: Obtain an urgent portable chest X-ray before intervening
pyq-norcet-2026.answerSource: AIIMS NORCET Master Answer Key (AIIMS Notice No. 124/2024 Official Master Answer Key)
pyq-norcet-2026.explanation: The clinical triad of absent unilateral breath sounds, contralateral tracheal deviation, and obstructive shock in a positive-pressure ventilated patient indicates Tension Pneumothorax. Immediate needle thoracostomy (2nd ICS mid-clavicular line) is required.

pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextOriginal: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-norcet-2026.questionTextDisplay: What is the specific antidote administered to neutralize Heparin-induced severe anticoagulation overdose?
pyq-norcet-2026.normalizationNotes: Deterministic OCR text extracted from official source document.
pyq-norcet-2026.answerSource: AIIMS NORCET Master Answer Key (AIIMS Notice No. 124/2024 Official Master Answer Key)
pyq-norcet-2026.explanation: Protamine Sulfate is a strongly basic polycationic peptide that binds ionically to strongly acidic, negatively charged Heparin molecules, creating a stable, inactive salt complex without anticoagulant properties.
